description: Search Amazon for home-office desk gear on the user's marketplace. Filter by role + budgetBand. Returns PA-API products when configured, otherwise desk-setup search deep-link cards + catalogMatches. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Amazon URLs omit tag= until tagConfigured is true. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es, en-US

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED — pass the user's storefront; curated ASINs only produce /dp links when trusted for that marketplace.

name: search_desk_gear
title: Search desk gear
